description: React component 'DayPlanner' responsible for rendering and managing activities within a day in a travel itinerary. Supports adding, editing, removing, and reordering activities.

methods.name: closeForm
methods.description: Closes the activity form modal/dialog by resetting mode and editing state.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new activity, assigning a unique ID and order, then updating parent.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing activity's details and updating parent component.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Removes an activity based on its ID and reorders remaining activities.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Reorders activities by moving an activity up or down in the list.
